site_area_sqm.formula: polygon_area(provisional_site_boundary, EPSG:4548); machine value retained for recomputation only; human display is 约 11.4 km²（参与者临时模型）
assumptions: Provisional boundary, not an official redline; do not present the machine value as a precise area.
Human-facing display: 约 11.4 km²（参与者临时模型）; recompute when official geometry and boundary data are published.

green_space_area_sqm.formula: union(conceptual green polygons, EPSG:4548); display reduced to integer sqm

public_space_area_sqm.formula: union(conceptual public-space polygons, EPSG:4548); display reduced to integer sqm

building_footprint_area_sqm.formula: union(conceptual reuse-first envelopes, EPSG:4548); display reduced to integer sqm

green_ratio.formula: green_space_area_sqm / site_area_sqm; machine ratio retained for recomputation; human display is 约 11%（参与者临时模型）
assumptions: Human-facing display: 约 11%（参与者临时模型）; concept green polygons are not official green-line data.

public_space_ratio.formula: public_space_area_sqm / site_area_sqm; machine ratio retained for recomputation; human display is 约 0.3%（参与者临时模型）
assumptions: Human-facing display: 约 0.3%（参与者临时模型）; concept public-space polygons are not official land-use data.

road_network_length_m.formula: sum(conceptual paths, EPSG:4548); display reduced to integer metres

industry_test_scenario_count.formula: count(industry validation protocol table rows in proposal.md section 'AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景'); each row fixes entry condition / verification method / exit-rollback trigger / result destination

scenario_card_count.formula: count(AI+ scenario card rows in proposal.md section 'AI 创新生态、人才画像与 AI+ 场景'); each card fills 11 fields (user/data/space/model/operator/human backstop/privacy control/failure mode/phase gate/effectiveness indicator/stop condition)

persona_count.formula: count(representative user groups in proposal.md '五类人才画像')

global_case_count.formula: count(global ecosystem mechanism cases: proposal.md case table rows equal sources.json SRC-GLOBAL-CASE-01..06)

annual_program_count.formula: count(annual event table rows in proposal.md section '更新项目清单、实施政策与分期计划')
